source: Czepiński 2023, Acta Palaeontologica Polonica 68(2): 227-243, Fig. 6A: phylogenetic relationships of Shri devi among dromaeosaurids, with coloured squares for two skull ratios; rectangular, root left, tips right, coloured boxes behind three subfamilies keyed to a legend. names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names (the quoted genus '"Velociraptor" osmolskae' and 'Velociraptor sp. (MPC-D 100/982)' as printed)
gold_note: Dromaeosaurid tree (panel A). Internal labels from the three shaded boxes via the colour legend: Dromaeosaurinae (yellow), Saurornitholestinae (green), Velociraptorinae (peach).
